# The retired concept names, with the files and lines that still carry each one.
#
# `concept-names` reads config/naming/concept_map.toml and compares the tree
# with this file. The numbers only go DOWN. A concept that gains a file or a
# line fails the gate. A concept whose count falls must have its number lowered
# here in the same change, so finished work is recorded instead of quietly
# banked. WP-43 sets the map to absolute mode at the end of T-Launch, and then
# every line here reaches zero.
#
# Format: <key>\t<files>\t<lines>
# The key is the new name in the map, lowercased, with punctuation folded to a
# hyphen. It is derived, never chosen: the map is written verbatim from the
# directive, and a hand-written key could drift from the name it stands for.
#
# Recorded: 2026-11-07, from a scan of the roots the map names. Every line below
# was measured; none was guessed.
